verdict.rationale: Inngest offers self-hosting and bring-your-own-encryption-key middleware, which give some indirect control over data, but there is no documented data retention policy, deletion API/workflow, or explicit user-facing controls for purging stored events/run state. missing for 10: explicit data retention configuration, a documented deletion/purge API or UI control, retention period settings for events/traces/state, and any independent confirmation of these controls working.
